indexLead: The rules {brand} works by, in plain language: what you buy from us, how keys reach your account, when we refund, and how we handle your data.
indexMetaDescription: Terms and conditions, privacy, cookies, refunds, delivery, payment, faulty keys, complaints and acceptable use at {brand}.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.scope: The contract between you and {company} for every key you buy on {brand}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.scope: The personal data we hold, why, who processes it for us, how long we keep it and your rights.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.scope: Each cookie and browser storage key the store sets, and how to change your choices.

returns.title: Refund policy
returns.scope: Cancelling before a key is issued, when we refund, and how and when refunds are paid.

shipping.title: Delivery
shipping.scope: How keys are issued to your account, how long it usually takes, regions and redeeming.

payment.title: Payment
payment.scope: Cards we accept, currencies, when you’re charged and how card details are kept away from us.

warranty.title: Key not working?
warranty.scope: Replacement or refund if a key doesn’t work, and a refund if it isn’t issued within {hours} hours.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.scope: How to complain, how fast we answer and where to go if you’re not satisfied.

acceptable-use.title: Acceptable use
acceptable-use.scope: What you may and may not do with the website, your account and your keys.
